review_candidates.description_excerpt: Partner with product managers and developers during design to lock down acceptance criteria and testability requirements upfront. What You Bring to the Table 5+ years of hands-on software quality experience, with a minimum of 3 years building and maintaining test automation at scale.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: We're searching for a Senior SDET who combines battle-tested automation expertise with a genuine appetite for GenAI-powered workflows. Partner with product managers and developers during design to lock down acceptance criteria and testability requirements upfront. Raise the bar for the team through rigorous code reviews of automation PRs, hands-on mentorship of junior engineers, and championing GenAI-assisted best practices organization-wide. What You Bring to the Table 5+ years of hands-on software quality experience, with a minimum of 3 years building and maintaining test automation at scale. Hands-on CI/CD experience — you've configured, debugged, and optimized automated test stages in Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps. Nice to Have API testing expertise with Postman, REST Assured, or Playwright.
